design: Rank-16 Qwen-shaped LoRA with original dropout 0.05 and original per-rank microbatch row counts in intra-node eight-rank DDP. ABBA non-reentrant Torch checkpoint full recompute versus early-stop recompute, both preserving RNG. Record elapsed synchronized rank-max, peak allocated memory, full first two numerical updates and moments.
rationale: Qwen training enables checkpointing and LoRA dropout. A test on the exact repeated projection geometries establishes any available recompute savings and whether saved RNG preserves updates, before touching full-model numerics.
resource_policy: Keep original GLM protected nodes, the two external KFD nodes and original unknown MiniCPM reservations. Equal source and resources for both arms. 72 GiB host/node; each node gates PCI and KFD before device use.
formal_qualification: Uses original row-count metadata only. Generated activations, isolated component training, no native model or A100 ratio claims.
